_source: CBP ruling N306640 (28 Oct 2019), first scenario: the band, crown, cone and blades of a Francis turbine runner cast, welded and rough machined in China, then final machined, balanced and inspected in Canada: CBP held China. In the D580 selection pool (Part 102, dated before 2024, in no development or held-out split) and excluded. Target by the D171 rule; plant capabilities at the target are an assumption.
